newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ford Belgium MD expects higher 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Ford Belgium MD expects higher 1996 profit.

text.p: The head of Ford Motor Company (Belgium) NV, the Belgian car import and distribution unit of the Ford Motor Company, said on Friday he expected profit to have grown in 1996.

"Based on higher market share, it looks as if the result is going to be higher," Richard Wright, Managing Director of Ford Motor Co. (Belgium) told Reuters. He was speaking on the first day of the biennial Brussels Truck and Motobike Show.
Wright said Ford captured 9.9 percent of the new car market in Belgium in 1996, lifting it to third place in the manufacturers' rankings from fourth a year earlier.
In Belgium and Luxembourg combined, Ford said it had a market share of more than 10 percent. Wright said it was the unit's best result for 17 years.
In a statement, Ford Belgium said 1997 "looked promising."
Ford Belgium had a net profit of 397 million Belgian francs in 1995, up from 329 million francs in 1994. Turnover slipped slightly to 19.4 billion Belgian francs from 21.5 billion.
